name: Pooja R. Sonar
tagline: Full-Stack Developer with a focus on building robust real-time systems and intelligent AI-powered applications.
about: Pooja Sonar is a results-driven Software Developer specializing in full-stack development, with a strong focus on the MERN stack, real-time systems, and AI-powered applications. Leveraging experience from diverse internships and her current role, she consistently engineers scalable web applications, optimizes front-end performance, and implements robust backend solutions using technologies like Node.js, Express, React, Next.js, and RabbitMQ. Pooja excels at building high-throughput real-time telemetry systems, crafting intuitive user interfaces, and integrating complex APIs for AI model inference. Her background as a hackathon achiever and former state chess player underscores her exceptional problem-solving abilities and strategic approach to complex challenges.
highlights: Architected real-time telemetry system (10K+ readings/min) via Cosmos DB change feed + Node.js, achieving 99.9% uptime.
Integrated Socket.IO WebSockets + MQTT to serve 500+ farms with <100ms UI latency.
Built Next.js (TypeScript) + Redux dashboards for 50+ sensor cards, anomalies, and alerts.
Implemented RabbitMQ message-driven flows to decouple services and enhance reliability for asynchronous tasks.
Developed an AI-powered, gamified coding preparation platform (AccessAI) using Gemini's API.
Built a full-fledged MERN backend clone of Chess.com, implementing Socket.IO for real-time gameplay.
Designed a MERN UI for a text summarization tool with role-based views and auditable operations.
Secured 3rd place in a Hackathon organized by GDSC ADGITM.
Represented as a Goa State Chess Player.

projects.name: AccessAI - CodeQuest (MERN)
projects.description: Developed AccessAI, an AI-powered, gamified coding preparation platform designed to help users master programming languages. This MERN stack application provides comprehensive educational content, engaging coding challenges, and AI-driven assistance leveraging Gemini's API, with support for languages including Solidity, JavaScript, CSS, and React.

projects.name: Chess.com Backend Clone (MERN)
projects.description: Engineered a robust, full-stack Chess.com backend clone using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) to accurately mimic real-time chess gameplay. Implemented advanced Socket.IO WebSockets, including rooms, namespaces, heartbeats, and seamless reconnection, to synchronize game moves, clocks, and actions like resign/draw with high fidelity. Designed and secured RESTful Express APIs for managing users, games, moves, and sessions, incorporating JWT (access and refresh tokens), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), rate limiting, and CORS policies.
